'''August 2001 Green Bay tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Hobbytown, Green Bay, Wisconsin on 25 August 2001. [[Matt Jensen]] won it. It is known from Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2896">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-26-episode-1-closed-in-green-bay-8-25d2896/ episode-1-closed-in-green-bay-8-25], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 26 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-26-episode-1-closed-in-green-bay-8-25d2896/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Hobbytown, Green Bay, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Jensen]]
